title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Gen G Educational Hub is an emerging education-focused organization dedicated to providing learners with high-quality academic support and skill-building programs. The hub aims to make education more accessible and engaging through innovative teaching methods and digital platforms. Team members collaborate to design and deliver learning experiences that support student success and long-term development. Gen G Educational Hub values creativity, integrity, and a learner-centric approach, creating an environment where professionals can contribute meaningfully to educational outcomes.
  
**Role Description**
The Digital Marketing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Chandigarh, India. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, drive lead generation, and support enrollment goals. Day-to-day tasks include managing social media channels, creating and scheduling content, monitoring campaign performance, and analyzing web traffic and engagement metrics. The Digital Marketing Manager will coordinate with internal teams to align marketing initiatives with academic programs, oversee digital advertising efforts, and maintain consistent brand messaging across all online platforms. The role also involves identifying new digital opportunities, preparing performance reports, and recommending data-driven improvements to marketing strategies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to plan and implement comprehensive Digital Marketing and Marketing strategies across multiple channels.
* Proficiency in Social Media Marketing, including content planning, audience engagement, and platform-specific best practices.
* Experience in Lead Generation through digital campaigns, landing pages, and targeted outreach.
* Strong skills in Web Analytics, with the ability to interpret data, track KPIs, and optimize campaigns based on insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and brand consistency.
* Experience with marketing tools and platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, email marketing tools) is beneficial.
* Ability to work collaboratively with academic and operations teams, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; prior experience in the education sector is an advantage.
